usedFor: Comments on a LinkedIn company page post open deals in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new comment is added to a post on a company page” in LinkedIn, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A comment is a real person reacting, pushed live, so the deal starts mid-conversation.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs the ID of an existing HubSpot deal, and the post trigger runs on a schedule.
